Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT / LAST OBSERVED: Character is beside the iron setup, northeast of the furnace, with its panel OPEN. Latest screenshot report: furnace Working, 3% smelting progress, SIX iron plates in output, FIVE wood in fuel slot; inventory has 21 iron plates and 30 copper plates. A 1-second wait executed AFTER that screenshot; subsequent output/progress is unobserved. Six output plates have NOT been collected. No held cursor item was reported after refueling. Last confirmed other supplies: one spare small electric pole, no spare wood or coal. Earlier one iron ore and eight magazines were not recently rechecked.

ACTIVE GOAL / PROGRESSION: Craft a lab. Research screen explicitly says Automation science pack is researched by crafting a lab; this is the next observed progression requirement, not a stated victory condition. Observed lab raw cost: 36 iron plates + 15 copper plates, electricity use up to 60 kW. With 21 iron held, the working target is 15 furnace output plates before collection; latest output was six, leaving nine more to produce if nothing else changes. No lab crafted yet. Steam power and Electronics are explicitly researched. Steam generation goal is COMPLETE: engine produced 400 W and a Steam power achievement confirmed electricity production by steam engine. No episode result observed.

CONTROLS / INTERACTION: E opens inventory/crafting or closes inventory/machine panels; closing preserves held cursor items. M toggles map/remote view. T opens research; Escape closes research, sometimes returning to a previous machine panel. WASD move cardinally; simultaneous keys move diagonally. Typical travel holds 1s, adjustments 0.1–0.8s. Negative scroll zooms out; most recent character-view change was -2, later remote-view zoom +3. Hover shows tooltips/highlights. Coordinates change with camera movement/zoom; retarget afterward. A first left-click often only highlights a machine, with a second click opening its panel; exact reach is unknown. Q successfully cleared the held spare pole after placement; subsequent inventory confirmed it remained available. Left-click picks up a stack; click empty inventory slot to store, matching stack to merge. Right-click takes half (8 wood→4, 4→2, 10 coal→5, 2→1 confirmed). Coal inserted into an occupied wood fuel slot swaps wood onto cursor. A machine click while holding fuel may only open its panel; fuel then requires a slot click.

MINING / CRAFTING: Hold J over reachable resource/tree. Progress persists between 1s holds; one hold may not finish. Ordinary harvested trees yielded four wood, confirmed by +4 Wood notifications. Yellow selection brackets preceded successful mining; red brackets and Cannot reach occurred when too far away. Tree trunks can be targetable when foliage is not; after moving, re-hover the trunk. Several unhighlighted plants gave no tooltip; one earlier J attempt gave no progress or wood. Decorative vegetation is a hypothesis, not established. Coal/stone resource mining yields one per completed cycle. Inspected big rock tooltip listed 20 stone and no coal, so it did not support the hoped-for fuel source. Recipe clicks automatically queue intermediates and reserve raw materials immediately. Crafting continues during travel; queue disappearance plus inventory confirmed completed items. Research pausing production remains an untested hypothesis. Empty fuel slots can still have residual burn energy and Working status; No ingredients can be temporary between drill deliveries.

IRON SETUP / RECENT HISTORY: Burner drill on western edge of iron field points north directly into stone furnace; ore transfer needs no inserter. Drill placement requires ore (red on bare ground, green on ore), mining area 2×2. Initially Target full before furnace placement. Both machines accept wood or coal. Drill repeatedly exhausted fuel, explicitly reporting No fuel with about 1,000 iron resources remaining; stoppage was not ore depletion. Collected six plates to reach seven, then spent four iron crafting inserter, leaving three. Later collected ten→13, then eight→21. Since reaching 21, output has remained in furnace. Latest drill intervention: four wood restarted it; later four more merged with its remaining three, showing Working at 87% with SEVEN wood. This was before another tree-harvesting trip and furnace interactions; current drill fuel is not reverified. Latest furnace intervention: four harvested wood merged with one remaining, confirmed FIVE fuel wood and Working. Output grew five→six during waits. No spare fuel remains in inventory. Northeast forest supplies four wood per tree; iron machines are southwest of that forest across the ore field. Both machines were producing during these trips, but future fuel sufficiency is not guaranteed.

CURRENT PANEL COORDINATES (normalized, only while view matches): Furnace output (0.733,0.542), furnace fuel (0.522,0.605), inventory iron stack (0.337,0.320), usual wood slot (0.289,0.320–0.330). Drill fuel slot in its panel (0.522,0.550). Latest world furnace clicks were approximately (0.440–0.450,0.519); do not reuse older world coordinates after movement.

STEAM NETWORK / CONFIRMED: On northeastern portion of the large lake's eastern shore, north of dense lakeside forest, southwest of wreck/resource area. Offshore pump outlet east feeds boiler immediately east without pipes; boiler water ports horizontal, steam outlet north; vertical steam engine immediately north. Pump→boiler confirmed by 200/200 water, boiler→engine by 200/200 steam at 165°C. Engine placement once failed due to blocked tile beside character; moving east 0.3s and retargeting made preview green. One small pole placed immediately east of engine, green preview with engine blue brackets inside supply area. Engine changed from Not plugged in electric network to Working, initially 0 W with 900 kW available. Boiler later explicitly No fuel; four of eight carried wood inserted, then Working with two fuel wood visible and four reserved. An electric inserter placed east/southeast of engine inside pole supply area showed Waiting for source items with full electricity bar. Engine then confirmed Workin
